	title = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.21.t
	desc = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.21.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.21.o0
		trigger = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_arms_offer }
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_arms_offer
				USA = {
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_grievance = yes
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.25 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					has_equipment = { infantry_weapons_1 > 999 }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_initial_package_used }
				}
			}
			USA = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.25 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				send_equipment = { type = infantry_weapons_1 amount = 1000 target = ROOT }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_initial_package_used
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.25 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_arms_offer
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_initial_aid_received
		}
	}
	option = { name = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.21.o1 clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_arms_offer }
}

		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes

					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_grievance = yes

					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.0071428571428571435 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			USA = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_stop_support = yes

				limit = { tag = KUR }
				USA = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_kur }
			}
			else = {
				USA = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_puk }
			}
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KUR_us_advisers
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_KUR_us_advisers days = 90 }

	}

		trigger = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_assembly_offer }

			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_assembly_offer
				USA = {
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.25 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_assembly_paid }
				}
			}
			USA = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.25 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_assembly_paid
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.25 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_assembly_received
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_assembly_offer
		}
	}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.30
	title = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.30.t
	desc = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.30.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_quote_accord = yes }
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.30.o0
		trigger = {
			tag = IRQ
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_campaign = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_can_fund_accord = yes
			OR = {
				KUR = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
				PUK = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_quote_accord = yes
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_can_fund_accord = yes }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_pending days = 30 }
			KUR = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_offer days = 30 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.31 }
				}
			}
			PUK = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_offer days = 30 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.31 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.30.o1
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_pending
		USA = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_to = 1 }
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_policy_offer
			}
		}
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.31
	title = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.31.t
	desc = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.31.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.31.o0
		trigger = {
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_offer
			IRQ = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_pending COLDWAR_USA_gulf_can_fund_accord = yes }
			OR = {
				NOT = { is_subject = yes }
				is_subject_of = IRQ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_offer
				OR = {
					NOT = { is_subject = yes }
					is_subject_of = IRQ
				}
				IRQ = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_pending COLDWAR_USA_gulf_can_fund_accord = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent
			IRQ = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_all_local_consent = yes COLDWAR_USA_gulf_can_fund_accord = yes }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_paid }
						}
						set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_invoice }
						multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
						modify_treasury_effect = yes
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_paid
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_accepted
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_fulfilled
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognize_kurdish_autonomy = yes
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_pending
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_offer
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.31.o1
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_offer
		IRQ = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_pending }
		KUR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_offer }
		PUK = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_offer }
		USA = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_to = 1 }
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_policy_offer
			}
		}
	}
}
